name: ForzaInfinity
description: Forza Horizon 2's online services, back on PC through Azimuth 0.9.10 and 0.9.9: online free roam and races, friends, car clubs, leaderboards, rivals, storefront and cloud saves.

paragraphs: Forza Horizon 2's online services, back for the PC version running on Azimuth 0.9.10 (recommended) or 0.9.9 (Windows, or Linux and the Steam Deck through Proton).
Requires Azimuth 0.9.10 or 0.9.9. The installers check the version. Updating Azimuth puts its own azimuth-tls.dll back, so run the installer again after each update.

Two profile types. When you create your profile you choose HARDCORE (a new career with your first car, progress checked by the server) or NOOB (your offline save as it is, no progress checks). HARDCORE and NOOB players never meet: everything below is kept within each type, except the storefront, which everyone shares. A HARDCORE profile can become NOOB later, never the other way round.
features: Friends: add each other by Name#12345 from the game, or with ADD FRIEND in any player's
Car Clubs: create, invite, roles, notice board.
Rivals and ghost races: every friend's best time on each route is a time to beat, with
Leaderboards: speed traps, speed zones, skill chains and race times against every player
